prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need a tester for a home, irrigation system, commercial building, or a fire line? Also what zip code or how far from Liberty, MO (e.g., within Liberty city limits, or 10–20 miles)? With that I can give more targeted options or a draft message/phone script to contact companies.

In the meantime, here’s how to find and pick a backflow tester/repair company near Liberty, MO:

Where to look
- Google Maps / Apple Maps: search “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester near Liberty, MO.”  
- Yelp, Angi (formerly Angie’s List), HomeAdvisor, Nextdoor for local reviews.  
- Local plumbing and irrigation companies — many plumbers and irrigation contractors perform backflow tests.  
- Your water utility or the City of Liberty Public Works / utilities department — they often maintain a list of approved or frequently used testers and can tell you required paperwork/forms.

What to ask/verify when you call
- Are you a certified backflow tester? Ask for tester name and certification/ID and the certifying organization.  
- Will you submit the test report to the City of Liberty / utility (or provide me a copy in the proper form)?  
- Do you carry liability insurance? (Important for commercial or fire line work.)  
- Have you worked on this type/brand/size of assembly before? (e.g., RPZ, double-check)  
- Rough cost for testing only and typical repair cost ranges (and whether parts/permit fees are extra).  
- Availability and turnaround time.

Typical costs (rough estimates)
- Testing-only: commonly $50–$150 per assembly for residential/irrigation; commercial or fire assemblies may be higher.  
- Repairs: highly variable — simple repairs/parts $100–$300; major repairs or replacement can be several hundred to over $1,000. Get a written estimate.

Local company types to try first
- Licensed plumbers in the Kansas City metro who list backflow services  
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (they often do residential backflow tests)  
- Fire protection contractors for fire-line backflow assemblies

If you want, tell me:
- property type (residential/commercial/fire), zip code, and how soon you need service — I’ll draft a short phone script and a checklist you can use to compare quotes.
